title: Rails patches critical Active Storage flaw with RCE potential
summary: The Rails team recommends upgrading to libvips 8.13 or later and rotating the ‘secret_key_base’ (the Rails master key), database credentials, Active Storage service credentials, and any other secrets accessible to the application process.
